high_value_findings.finding: Model output was sensitive to control-instruction placement and could repeat natural-language control tags. Persona/session adapter state materially shaped behavior.
high_value_findings.transfer: Use structural control channels and explicit adapter/session state; never assume a system prompt alone is semantically dominant or invisible.

high_value_findings.finding: Idle thought diversity and reflection frequency were directly altered by a prompt pool, anti-repetition instructions, token budget and hardware/idle gates.
high_value_findings.transfer: Measure autonomous/emergent behavior against prompt/gate ablations; do not count scaffolded variety as unprompted emergence.

high_value_findings.finding: Heavy-model VRAM arbitration required serialized swap transitions, service masking, health checks, lock ordering and emergency rollback.
high_value_findings.transfer: Treat scarce-resource routing as a reversible state machine with explicit authority, health and rollback rather than ad-hoc process starts/stops.

high_value_findings.finding: Internal world-state was continuously available but prompt policy was changed to keep it behaviorally influential without routinely reading metrics back to the user.
high_value_findings.transfer: Separate state availability from salience/disclosure policy in GWT/context routing.

high_value_findings.finding: Historical documentation mixes design narrative, philosophical interpretation, time-local topology and at least one large hallucinated authoritative document with fabricated people. Commit titles can also diverge from the actual diff.
high_value_findings.transfer: Documentation is an evidence source only with provenance class and diff/tree/runtime corroboration; generated institutional/person claims require explicit verification.

high_value_findings.finding: The early release lineage repaired hardcoded paths and added model checksum verification, target-mount disk checks and bounded service startup handling.
high_value_findings.transfer: Release correctness includes portable path resolution, artifact integrity hashes and target-like preflight/installation validation.

negative_results_preserved: Natural-language generation-control text leaked into visible responses.
Raw idle-thought diversity was heavily scaffolded by explicit prompt pools and thresholds.
A generated 2384-line documentation artifact invented team members and authoritative-looking history.
Commit-message/documentation wording could disagree with actual ordinal diff evidence.
Early launchers contained hardcoded host paths requiring later portability fixes.
epistemic_boundary: GRF-to-system mappings, consciousness/experience wording and 'emergent behavior' documentation are preserved as historical design claims. This pass does not promote them into empirical proof of phenomenal consciousness, scientific novelty or current runtime behavior.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual dedup against the earned-work ledger was performed.

next_falsifiers: A/B test structured control channels versus natural-language tags and measure tag leakage/instruction adherence.
Ablate idle prompt rotation, repetition guards and gate thresholds to estimate scaffold-dependent versus endogenous diversity.
Fault-inject each heavy-model swap transition and assert rollback plus single-active-heavy-model invariant.
Run generated documentation through entity/provenance verification and diff/runtime claim checking before publication.
Clean-install from the root/release lineage with checksum corruption and alternate model mountpoints.
